games.name: Terraria 3D
games.description: A walk-anywhere 3D recreation of Terraria. Requires your own Terraria copy (Steam). Multiplayer with friends.
games.notes:
Play with me:
- Easiest: Multiplayer > "Join Ottof's server", pick a character (when my server is on).
- Or with Tailscale (https://tailscale.com/download): accept my share link, then Multiplayer > Join via IP > my 100.x.x.x address.
We need the same version: update here when PackSync says there's a new one. Full steps: README.txt in the game folder, under "Play with a friend".

games.name: Last Load
games.description: Co-op horror for 1-4. Haul a dead stranger's things, sell them at the pawn shop, make rent in 3 nights.
games.notes: One person clicks Host game and shares the lobby code (Copy button). Everyone else pastes it and clicks Join. Use voice chat, but don't trust every voice you hear.
games.changelog: Casino overhaul: bigger Bayou Belle floor and new exterior, real-casino slot cabinets with video screens and the Last Load theme, over-the-top win celebrations, chip roll-ups and casino hooks; free bar drinks with a Seeing Double drunk effect; riverboat scratch-off kiosk with $1-$50 tickets; card and roulette cameras (V); slots pay out only after the reels stop. Fixes: charge prompt only when an item is dead, attic ladder needs a click, spiral stairs widened, room under stairs, outhouse rope while carrying, phone grip, SitePad charge pose, floating props, lag on item pickup, smoother loading drive, flashlight wording.
